title: Workers
subtitle.long: REUSEPORT worker-process pool. Each worker is a separate OS process bound SO_REUSEPORT; the kernel load-balances accepts across them. Per-worker CPU and RAM refresh every 5 s.
error.title: ERROR
host.title: HOST
layout.title: RUNTIME LAYOUT
rec.title: Topology recommendation
table.title: WORKER PROCESSES
table.desc: One row per running worker process. CPU% is a short rolling average — values refresh every 5 s.
reuseport.title: Connection load balancing
reuseport.desc: When enabled, the kernel distributes incoming connections across all worker processes — the same model as nginx. This eliminates the accept-lock bottleneck and improves multi-core throughput.
reuseport.label: Connection sharing across workers
reuseport.restartBanner: Connection load balancing changed — restart required to rebind worker sockets.
reuseport.expertHint: Changing the worker binding layout requires a full service restart. Do not toggle under active traffic without a maintenance window.
desired.title: Desired worker count
desired.desc: Auto picks one worker per CPU core (thread-per-core). Custom pins an exact count. Worker count is fixed at process startup — saving here stores the value but does not change the running pool.
desired.restartHint: Worker count cannot change on a live process — each worker is a separate connection-balanced process. The pool above is unchanged until you run the command below.
toast.desiredSavedRestart: Restart required to apply — see the command below.
